استفعلوا (form X)
# اِسْتَفْعَلُوا (istafʕalū) /is.taf.ʕa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَفْعَلَ (istafʕala)
# اُسْتُفْعِلُوا (ustufʕilū) /us.tuf.ʕi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَفْعَلَ (istafʕala)
# اِسْتَفْعِلُوا (istafʕilū) /is.taf.ʕi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَفْعَلَ (istafʕala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
